feature.title: Feature: {topic}
feature.text: A feature: {topic}. The chain runs as your child tickets; wrap them into one answer: what was built, the PR, the review verdict, what the owner must decide.

steps.title: Design: {topic}
steps.text: Design the change for: {topic}. Files to touch, the data changes, the API shape, the risks, the tests to write. No code yet. NOTHING TO SEND.

steps.title: Build: {topic}
steps.text: Build the design from the previous step on a branch named feature/<slug>, with tests. Report the branch, the files changed and the test output. NOTHING TO SEND.

steps.title: Tests: {topic}
steps.text: Run the suite on the branch from the previous step and add the tests the change still needs. Report the command, the output and what you added. NOTHING TO SEND.

steps.title: Review: {topic}
steps.text: Review the branch cold: findings with file, line, severity and fix, most severe first; then a verdict. NOTHING TO SEND.

steps.title: PR: {topic}
steps.text: If the review has no blocker, write the pull request (title, body with what and why, test evidence, the review summary) and open it under AFTER YOUR OK. If there is a blocker, say what must change first.

incident.title: Incident: {topic}
incident.text: An incident: {topic}. Read-out first, fix second, never a deploy without the OK.

steps.title: Read-out: {topic}
steps.text: From the logs and the error tracker: what is failing, since when, how many users, the likely cause. Six lines. NOTHING TO SEND.

steps.title: Fix: {topic}
steps.text: The smallest fix for the cause in the previous step, on a branch hotfix/<slug>, with a test that fails before and passes after. NOTHING TO SEND.

steps.title: Review the hotfix
steps.text: Review the hotfix branch: is it the smallest safe change? Verdict and findings. NOTHING TO SEND.

steps.title: Deploy plan: {topic}
steps.text: If the review passes, write the deploy and the rollback under AFTER YOUR OK with the exact commands and the check that proves it worked.
